name: San Domenico
lunchNote: Colazione di lavoro business lunch, Tuesday to Friday (Radici €185 also served)
lunchNoteIt: Colazione di lavoro, da martedì a venerdì (anche Radici €185)

menus.name: Radici tasting menu
menus.note: The restaurant's best-known dishes, including the Uovo in Raviolo; lunch or dinner; for the whole table; white truffle instead of black €25 a dish; alcohol-free pairing €80

menus.name: Orizzonti tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner; for the whole table; alcohol-free pairing €100

menus.name: Colazione di lavoro business lunch
menus.note: A first course, a main and dessert, with appetisers and petits fours; Tuesday to Friday lunch only, not on public holidays; for the whole table

menus.name: Mercoledì 70 menu
menus.note: Only for guests born in 1970 or later, on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays; includes wines by the glass, water and coffee

bookingOpens: Online through the booking page on the restaurant's website, or by phone or email (sandomenico@sandomenico.it). From January to April it is closed on Sundays and Mondays; from May to September on Saturday lunchtime, Sundays and Mondays.
groups: Saletta22, a private room with its own chef's table, can be booked for a blind menu with wines.
